sentence: This project studies pinhole borer beetles and their symbiotic fungi, using DNA sequencing and microscopy to identify and describe them.
This project builds an automated platform that prepares long DNA strands for sequencing using an electric field in a microscale flow cell.
This project builds tools that detect malicious connections to science cyberinfrastructure by looking at the structure of the addresses they come from.
This project studies what human preferences really mean so that AI systems can learn from them more accurately.
This project builds wearable brain-imaging technology using flexible magnetic sensors that measure weak magnetic signals produced by the brain at room temperature.
This project builds tools that use graphs to analyze high-dimensional data by using the low-dimensional structure hidden in the data.
This project develops a laser spectroscopy method that measures oxygen isotopes using a condensable carrier gas.
This project builds mathematical tools for combining high-dimensional datasets by finding the low-dimensional structures they share.
This project expands the use of AI in teaching and research at a university, adding AI to fields such as psychology and agriculture.
This project builds computer tools that use two-dimensional mass spectrometry to work out peptide sequences, including peptides with chemical modifications.
This project tests thousands of synthetic RNAs to find which features change the amount and timing of protein production.
This project builds a virtual reality tool that measures children's empathy from their behaviors during role-playing, using Artificial Intelligence.
This project studies whether large AI data centers could cause widespread power outages in future electric grids and builds controls to improve grid resilience.
This project tracks the water, nutrients and salt in streams across watersheds with different amounts of urbanization.
This project builds artificial intelligence software that predicts how a new coronavirus behaves from its genome sequence.
